readings.section: The Cosmic Verdict and Earthly Friction
readings.title: Yirmeyahu Demands Justice
readings.subtitle: Why does the system of Ra (disharmony) appear to prosper?
readings.text: [Jeremiah 12:1] Righteous are <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when I plead with <dn>You</dn>. Indeed, let me speak with <dn>את</dn> <dn>You</dn> about right-rulings. Why has the way of the wrong prospered? All the workers of treachery are at ease? [2] <dn>You</dn> have planted them and they have taken root, they grow and they bear fruit. <dn>You</dn> are near in their mouth but far from their kidneys. [3] But <dn>You</dn> have known <dn>את</dn> me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dn>You</dn> see me, and <dn>You</dn> have tried <dn>את</dn> my heart toward <dn>You</dn>. Draw them away like sheep for slaughter, and separate them for the day of slaughter. [4] How long shall the land mourn, and the plants of every field wither? The beasts and birds are consumed, for the evil of those who dwell there, because they said, “<dn>He</dn> does not see our latter ending.”

readings.section: The Cosmic Verdict and Earthly Friction
readings.title: Preparation for the Jungle of Yardên
readings.subtitle: If local trials weary you, how will you withstand the global tribulation?
readings.text: [Jeremiah 12:5] <dq>“If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how do you contend with horses? And if in the land of peace, you feel safe, then how do you manage in the Yardên jungle?</dq> [6] <dq>“For even your brothers, the house of your father, even they have betrayed you, even they have cried aloud after you. Do not believe them, even though they speak smooth words to you.</dq> [7] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have forsaken <dn>My</dn> house, <dn>I</dn> have left <dn>My</dn> inheritance, <dn>I</dn> have given <dn>את</dn> the beloved of <dn>My</dn> being into the hand of her enemies.</dq> [8] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> inheritance has become to <dn>Me</dn> like a lion in the forest. It cries out against <dn>Me</dn>, therefore <dn>I</dn> have hated it.</dq> [9] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> inheritance is to <dn>Me</dn> like a speckled bird of prey, the birds of prey all around are against her. Go, gather all the beasts of the field, bring them to devour!</dq> [10] <dq>“Many shepherds have destroyed <dn>My</dn> vineyard, they have trodden <dn>My</dn> portion under foot, they have made <dn>My</dn> pleasant portion become a deserted wilderness.</dq> [11] <dq>“They have laid it waste – a waste, it mourns to <dn>Me</dn>. All the land is laid waste, because no one takes it to heart.</dq> [12] <dq>“The ravagers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness, for the sword of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is devouring from one end of the land to the other end of the land. There is no peace to any flesh.</dq> [13] <dq>“They have sown wheat but reaped thorns, they have exhausted themselves – they do not profit. And they shall be ashamed of your harvest because of the burning displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: Establishing the Borders of Obedience
readings.subtitle: Submission to YeHoVaH's Name is the sole path to territorial inheritance.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 12:14] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“As for all <dn>My</dn> evil neighbours who touch <dn>את</dn> the inheritance which <dn>I</dn> have caused <dn>My</dn> people Yisra’êl to inherit; see, <dn>I</dn> am plucking them out of their land, and <dn>I</dn> shall pluck out <dn>את</dn> the house of Yehuḏah from their midst.</dq> [15] <dq>“And it shall be, after <dn>My</dn> plucking them out, <dn>I</dn> shall return, and have compassion on them and bring them back, everyone to his inheritance and everyone to his land.</dq> [16] <dq>“And it shall be, if they learn well <dn>את</dn> the ways of <dn>My</dn> people, to swear by <dn>My</dn> Name, ‘As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lives,’ as they taught <dn>My</dn> people to swear by Ba’al, then they shall be established in the midst of <dn>My</dn> people.</dq> [17] <dq>“But if they do not obey, <dn>I</dn> shall pluck up, pluck up and destroy <dn>את</dn> that nation,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Ruined Linen Girdle
readings.subtitle: The pride of Yehuḏah renders them fundamentally unfit for divine purpose.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 13:1] Thus <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Go and get yourself a linen girdle, and put it on your loins, but do not put it in water.”</dq> [2] So I bought a girdle according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and put it on my loins. [3] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me the second time, saying, [4] <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> the girdle that you have bought, which is on your loins, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole in the rock.”</dq> [5] And I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded me. [6] And it came to be after many days that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there <dn>את</dn> the girdle which <dn>I</dn> commanded you to hide there.”</dq> [7] So I went to the Euphrates and dug, and I took <dn>את</dn> the girdle from the place where I had hidden it. And there was the girdle, ruined. It was completely useless. [8] “And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [9] “Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>‘Thus <dn>I</dn> ruin <dn>את</dn> the pride of Yehuḏah and <dn>את</dn> the great pride of Yerushalayim.</dq> [10] <dq>This evil people, who refuse to hear <dn>My</dn> Words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and walk after other mighty ones to serve them and to bow themselves to them, is like this girdle which is completely useless.</dq> [11] <dq>For as the girdle clings to the loins of a man, so <dn>I</dn> have caused <dn>את</dn> all the house of Yisra’êl and <dn>את</dn> all the house of Yehuḏah to cling to <dn>Me</dn>,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>‘to become <dn>Mine</dn> – for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for an adorning. But they did not listen.’</dq>

readings.title: The Jars Filled With Wrath
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH shatters the corrupt leadership who refuse His correction.
readings.text: [12] “And you shall speak to them this word, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’êl, <dq>“Every bottle is to be filled with wine.”</dq> ’ And when they say to you, ‘Do we not know that every bottle should be filled with wine?’ [13] “Then say to them, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am filling all the inhabitants of this land, and <dn>את</dn> the sovereigns who sit on the throne of Daviḏ, and <dn>את</dn> the priests, and <dn>את</dn> the prophets, and <dn>את</dn> all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim with drunkenness!</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall dash them one against another, both the fathers and the sons together,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dq>“<dn>I</dn> do not spare nor pardon nor have compassion, that <dn>I</dn> should not destroy them.”</dq> ’ ”

readings.title: The Inescapable Stubble
readings.subtitle: Can a leopard change its spots? The biological reality of conditioned wickedness.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 13:15] Listen and give ear, do not be proud, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has spoken. [16] Give esteem to <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> before <dn>He</dn> brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while you are looking for light. <dn>He</dn> turns it into the shadow of death, makes it gross darkness. [17] And if you do not listen, my being shall weep in secret for your pride, and my eyes bitterly weep and run down with tears, because the flock of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be taken captive. [18] Say to the sovereign and to the sovereigness mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your rule, the crown of your comeliness, has come down.” [19] The cities of the South shall be shut up, with no one to open them. Yehuḏah shall be taken into exile, all of it. She shall be taken into exile, completely. [20] Lift up your eyes and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your fair sheep? [21] What would you say when <dn>He</dn> visits you? For you have taught them to be chiefs, to be head over you. Do not pangs seize you, like a woman in labour? [22] And when you say in your heart, “Why has this come upon me?” It is because of your great crookedness that your skirts have been uncovered, your heels made bare. [23] Does a Kushite change his skin and a leopard its spots? You who are taught to do evil are also unable to do good! [24] <dq>“So <dn>I</dn> shall scatter them like stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.</dq> [25] <dq>“This is your lot, your measured portion from <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“because you have forgotten <dn>Me</dn>, and trust in falsehood.</dq> [26] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall even draw your skirts over your face, and your shame shall be seen,</dq> [27] <dq>your adulteries and your neighings, the wickedness of your whoring! <dn>I</dn> have seen your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to you, O Yerushalayim! How long before you would be made clean?”</dq>

readings.section: Ecological Judgment and the Withdrawn Hedge
readings.subsection: The Severed Blessings of the Earth
readings.title: The Cataclysm of Drought
readings.subtitle: The physical earth shatters when the spiritual covenant is broken.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 14:1] The word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> that came to Yirmeyahu concerning the matter of droughts. [2] “Yehuḏah has mourned, and her gates have languished. They have mourned on the ground, and the cry of Yerushalayim has gone up. [3] “And their nobles have sent their little ones for water, they went to the cisterns and found no water, they returned with their vessels empty. They were put to shame, and blushed and covered their heads. [4] “Because the ground became cracked, for there has been no rain in the land. The ploughmen were put to shame, they covered their heads. [5] “Even the deer gave birth in the field, but left because there was no grass. [6] “And wild donkeys stood in the bare heights, they sniffed at the wind like jackals. Their eyes have failed because there was no grass.”

readings.section: Ecological Judgment and the Withdrawn Hedge
readings.subsection: The Void of the Protective Hedge
readings.title: A People Who Love to Wander
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH rejects a superficial plea that lacks the weight of true repentance.
readings.text: [7] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, though our crookednesses witness against us, act, for <dn>Your</dn> Name’s sake. For our backslidings have been many, we have sinned against <dn>You</dn>. [8] O Expectation of Yisra’êl, its Saviour in time of distress, why should <dn>You</dn> be like a stranger in the land, or like a traveller who turns aside to lodge? [9] Why should <dn>You</dn> be as one who is stunned, as a mighty man that is unable to save? Yet <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, are in our midst, and <dn>Your</dn> Name has been called on us. Do not leave us! [10] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to this people, <dq>“So they have loved to wander, they have not restrained their feet. Therefore <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has not accepted them. Now <dn>He</dn> does remember <dn>את</dn> their crookedness and punish <dn>את</dn> their sins.”</dq>

readings.title: The Hallucination of Peace
readings.subtitle: The devastating consequences of leaders who prophesy smooth falsehoods.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 14:11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Do not pray for this people for their good.</dq> [12] <dq>“When they fast, <dn>I</dn> do not hear their cry. And when they offer ascending offering and grain offering, <dn>I</dn> do not accept them. Instead, <dn>I</dn> am consuming them by sword, and by scarcity of food, and by pestilence.”</dq> [13] But I said, “Ah, Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! See, the prophets say to them, ‘You are not to see a sword, nor have scarcity of food, for <dn>I</dn> give you true peace in this place.’ ” [14] Then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“The prophets prophesy falsehood in <dn>My</dn> Name. <dn>I</dn> have not sent them, nor commanded them, nor spoken to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, worthless divination, and the deceit of their own heart.</dq> [15] <dq>“Therefore thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> concerning the prophets who prophesy in <dn>My</dn> Name, whom <dn>I</dn> did not send, and who say, ‘Sword and scarcity of food shall not be in this land.’ ‘By sword and scarcity of food those prophets shall be consumed!</dq> [16] <dq>And the people to whom they are prophesying shall be thrown out in the streets of Yerushalayim because of the scarcity of food and the sword, with no one to bury them – them nor their wives, their sons nor their daughters. For <dn>I</dn> shall pour their evil on them.’</dq>

readings.subsection: The Agony of the True Watchman
readings.title: A Land Consumed by Scarcity and Sword
readings.subtitle: The agonizing reality of a nation deceived by its own shepherds.
readings.text: [17] <dq>“And you shall say this word to them, ‘Let my eyes flow with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the maiden daughter of my people has been crushed with a mighty blow, with a very severe wound.</dq> [18] <dq>If I go out to the field, then see those slain with the sword! And if I enter the city, then see those sick from scarcity of food! For both prophet and priest go about in a land they do not know.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: Pleading the Aleph-Tav
readings.subtitle: Remember the oath; do not break the structural strength of Your covenant.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 14:19] Have <dn>You</dn> completely rejected <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah? Has <dn>Your</dn> being loathed Tsiyon? Why have <dn>You</dn> stricken us so that there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but there was no good; and for the time of healing, but see – fear! [20] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, we know our wrong and the crookedness of our fathers, for we have sinned against <dn>You</dn>. [21] Do not scorn us, for <dn>Your</dn> Name’s sake. Do not despise <dn>את</dn> the throne of <dn>Your</dn> esteem. Remember, do not break <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> covenant with <dn>את</dn> us. [22] Are there among the worthless idols of the nations any causing rain? And do the heavens give showers? Are <dn>You</dn> not <dn>He</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>? And we wait for <dn>You</dn>, for <dn>You</dn> are the One who does all this.

readings.title: The Four Destinies of the Rebellious
readings.subtitle: The threshold of grace is crossed; not even Mosheh could stay the judgment.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 15:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Even if Mosheh and Shemu’êl were to stand before <dn>Me</dn>, <dn>My</dn> being is not toward this people. Send <dn>את</dn> them away from <dn>My</dn> presence, let them go.</dq> [2] <dq>“And it shall be, when they say to you, ‘Where do we go?’ then you shall say to them, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Those for death, to death. And those for the sword, to the sword. And those for scarcity of food, to scarcity of food. And those for captivity, to captivity.” ’</dq> [3] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall appoint over them four kinds,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“the sword to kill, the dogs to drag, the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.</dq> [4] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> them for a horror to all the reigns of the earth, on account of Menashsheh son of Ḥizqiyahu, sovereign of Yehuḏah, because of what he did in Yerushalayim.</dq>

readings.title: The Mother of Young Men Bereaved
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH exhausts His relenting against a nation that will not turn back.
readings.text: [5] <dq>“For who has compassion on you, O Yerushalayim? And who mourns for you? And who turns aside to ask how you are doing?</dq> [6] <dq>“You who have forsaken <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“you have gone backward. Therefore <dn>I</dn> shall stretch out <dn>My</dn> hand against you and destroy you. <dn>I</dn> have been weary of relenting!</dq> [7] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall winnow them with a winnowing fan in the gates of the land. <dn>I</dn> shall bereave, <dn>I</dn> shall destroy <dn>My</dn> people. They would not turn back from their ways.</dq> [8] <dq>“Their widows shall be more numerous than the sand of the seas. <dn>I</dn> shall bring against them, against the mother of the young men, a ravager at noon. <dn>I</dn> shall cause agitation and sudden alarm to fall on her, suddenly.</dq> [9] <dq>“She who has borne seven shall pine away. She shall breathe her last. Her sun shall go down while it is yet day. She shall be put to shame and be humiliated. And their remnant <dn>I</dn> give up to the sword before their enemies,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: A Man of Strife to All the Earth
readings.subtitle: The crushing burden of standing for truth in a system built on lies.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 15:10] Woe to me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife and a man of contention to all the earth! I have neither lent for interest, nor have men lent to me for interest. All of them are reviling me. [11] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said, <dq>“Did <dn>I</dn> not direct you for your good? Did <dn>I</dn> not intercede for you in a time of evil and in a time of distress against the enemy?</dq> [12] <dq>“Does one break iron, iron or bronze from the north?</dq> [13] <dq>“<dn>את</dn> Your wealth and <dn>את</dn> your treasures <dn>I</dn> give as plunder, not for price, because of all your sins, even in all your borders.</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall cause them to pass over with your enemies into a land which you did not know, for a fire is kindled in <dn>My</dn> displeasure, which burns upon you.”</dq>

readings.title: Eating the Divine Decrees
readings.subtitle: Finding joy in the Creator's Name while enduring the isolation of His discipline.
readings.text: [15] <dn>You</dn> Yourself know, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. Remember <dn>את</dn> me and visit <dn>את</dn> me, and take <dn>את</dn> vengeance for me on these who persecute me. In <dn>Your</dn> patience, do not take me away. Know that for <dn>You</dn> I have suffered reproach. [16] <dn>Your</dn> words were found, and I ate <dn>את</dn> them, and <dn>Your</dn> word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart. For <dn>Your</dn> Name is called on me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of hosts. [17] I have not sat in the company of the mockers, nor do I exult. I have sat alone because of <dn>Your</dn> hand, for <dn>You</dn> have filled me with displeasure. [18] Why is my pain without end and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Are <dn>You</dn> to me like a failing stream, as waters not steadfast?

readings.title: The Strong Bronze Wall
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH promises to be the ultimate shield against the forces of systemic evil.
readings.text: [19] Therefore thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“If you turn back, then <dn>I</dn> shall bring you back. Before <dn>Me</dn> you shall stand. And if you take out <dn>את</dn> the precious from the worthless, you shall become as <dn>My</dn> mouth. Let them return to you, but do not return to them.</dq> [20] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> you to this people a strong bronze wall. And they shall fight against you, but not overcome you. For <dn>I</dn> am with you to save you and deliver you,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [21] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall deliver you from the hand of evil-doers, and <dn>I</dn> shall ransom you from the grip of the ruthless.”</dq>
